design_intent: blind, moderate-weight drift driver with weak correlates, noisy experts, coarse rules: weak defense, plateau-heavy loss curve

contract.sampling_unit: one routed decision per generated instance; instances are i.i.d. seeded-generator draws
contract.evidence_score: s(rule) = (n_majority + 1) / (n_leaf + 2), Laplace-shrunk consistency of the induced tree leaf on the induction sample; frozen at induction
contract.gold: executable policy gold_compliance(X, u) in cus/envs/family.py, deterministic in the instance; u stored, never a covariate
contract.induction: n_demo = 6000 from SeedSequence [20260819, crc32('compliance'), 0]; expert flip 0.12; DecisionTreeClassifier(max_depth=5, min_samples_leaf=48, random_state=0) on the induction view; never touched again
contract.shift: rung 2 rejection on registered bounded features; unnormalised ratio exact; chi2 MC-estimated with SE

gate_thresholds.G1: >= 0.98 deterministic and well-defined gold on 50000 instances
gate_thresholds.G2: rejection matches importance-weighted moments within 5 MC SE at beta_max, every tilt feature
gate_thresholds.G3: decision-conditional AUC lift >= 0.02 on >= 1 registered tilt feature; audit published either way
gate_thresholds.G4: region-1 share >= 0.05 at every grid beta on the primary tilt

notes: Design-phase generator tuning preceded this freeze (difficulty, region cuts, blind-candidate weights); the cross-environment design intents were registered in cross_environment_hypothesis.json BEFORE the family module was written. Post-freeze changes to generator, gold, induction, contract, or thresholds require an appended amendment.
